fact: The 2023 World Bank diagnostic says Djibouti introduced e-money issuer rules in 2017 (Instruction, 100 million DJF initial capital) and that the BCD's ATS phase 1 connected all banks in 2021, with phase 2 planned for 2024 to connect non-bank payment providers via a gateway.
title: Rapport du diagnostic de l'économie numérique de Djibouti
